newsitem.title: USA: New York Bagel buys Santa Fe franchisee.
newsitem.headline: New York Bagel buys Santa Fe franchisee.

text.p: New York Bagel Enterprises Inc said Monday it acquired its Santa Fe, N.M. franchisee, Jeff Eateries LP, for about $84,000 plus assumption of about $160,000 of certain liabilities.
It said it hired the operating partner of the franchisee to manage the Santa Fe market for the company.
The bagel restaurant company also said it entered into a lease to develop a second company-owned outlet in Santa Fe.
Separately, New York Bagel said during its third fiscal quarter ended September 29 it opened its first company restaurant in Springfield, Mo., and third company-owned unit in Stillwater, Okla.
